subject: ClearWave expansion: additional apps, API keys & term amendment
messages:
From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@clearwave.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.k@clearwave.io>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion: additional projects + pricing question

Hi Chloe —

Quick note from our side: after the pilot last quarter the product teams want to onboard two more internal projects (PatientTriage and ClaimsAssist). Estimated monthly token volume would increase by ~2.1B tokens. We also want separate API keys for each new project for logging/segmentation.

A couple of asks:
- Can we keep existing committed capacity but add burst capacity for the two projects?
- Any material change to unit pricing if we add 2B tokens/month on top of current commit?
- We need a rollout checklist and a short timeline we can share with engineering (keys, env segregation, rate limits).

CCing Priya from ops to loop in procurement and schedule a short call.

Thanks,
Jason
Director of Product
ClearWave Health

[attachment: traffic-projections.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@clearwave.io>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.k@clearwave.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: additional projects + pricing question

Hi Jason —

Great to hear the pilot went well and that teams want to broaden usage. Short answers up front: yes — we can issue per-project API keys; we can enable burst capacity on top of your existing commit; and we have a standard amendment flow for adding committed units with pro-rated terms.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll draft an amendment that adds the two projects and the extra committed tokens (we can do a blended unit price for the incremental 2B).
2) Monica will propose a rollout checklist and keys naming convention for the two projects.
3) Laura can lead the procurement/finance items for a clean PR and invoice cadence.
4) Schedule a 30-min call later this week to confirm numbers & timeline.

Can you share the estimated go-live dates for PatientTriage and ClaimsAssist? That’ll help us set key expiry and staging windows.

I’m attaching our standard amendment template and a condensed rollout checklist — feel free to mark anything you want changed.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

[attachment: ClearWave_AMENDMENT_v2.pdf (PDF stub)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Lee <jason.lee@clearwave.io>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@clearwave.io>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: additional projects + pricing question

Thanks Chloe — looping in implementation details below. Jason / Priya: posting a draft rollout plan here so engineering has something concrete.

Rollout checklist (high level):
- API keys: create two distinct keys: clearwave.patienttriage.{env} and clearwave.claimsassist.{env} (dev/stage/prod).
- Quotas: apply per-key rate limits; recommend burst capacity throttle of 2x on prod for first 6 weeks.
- KV/prefix caching: PatientTriage will benefit from prefix caching; we’ll propose a 30s cache TTL initially.
- Telemetry: set up per-key cost tags and tracing for token-level attribution.
- Security: add keys to your internal secret manager; we can rotate keys every 90 days (optional).
- Test plan: 2-week staging window, smoke tests, and one blue/green switch for prod.
- Rollout owner: ClearWave to assign a single technical owner, Redwood to assign Monica as onboarding lead.

Timeline proposal:
- Week 1: Sign amendment + key provisioning
- Week 2: Staging keys + smoke tests
- Week 3: Prod keys + cutover window

Open items for pricing/procurement: Laura — can you confirm whether ClearWave prefers invoice timing on amendment signature or aligned with billing period?

Ben — I’ve attached a CSV with the checklist and recommended config. I can hop on the call to walk through.

- Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

[attachment: clearwave-rollout-checklist.csv (CSV stub)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@clearwave.io>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@clearwave.io>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Oct 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: additional projects + pricing question

Hi Jason / Priya —

Thanks for the details. We’ve prepared an amendment (attached) that:
- Adds two project identifiers to your account, each with separate API keys.
- Increases committed tokens by 2,000,000,000 / month for the remainder of your annual term.
- Applies a blended incremental rate of $0.0028 per token for the added volume (reflects a 12% discount on list).

Invoice timing: we can either:
A) Pro-rate the incremental commitment from signature date and invoice on the next regular billing run, or
B) Post a one-time pro-rated invoice immediately and then resume normal monthly invoices.

Please reply with preferred option and confirm go-live week (Monica’s timeline above). Once you confirm, I’ll send a DocuSign link and route to finance.

If helpful, we can consolidate the amendment + key provisioning into a single delivery milestone so your SREs only need one cutover window.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
